plain_description.what: An earlier test found the tree's leaves less pure than a flat clustering with the same number of groups on one MMLU-Pro draw. This test repeats the comparison on three other label-free tree re-draws. It also checks whether the label-anchored tree loses to a flat clustering, either with the same number of groups (84) or one that is also guided by the labels.
plain_description.why: It asks whether 'the tree partitions worse than flat clustering' is a one-off or a general property of the construction.
plain_description.information: Result (no new calls, no new builds): the purity loss reappears on 2 of 3 re-draws (one only narrowly) but not the third. The second measure, key information, loses on none. The anchored tree does not lose to either flat comparison, but that is descriptive only and is not a tie. The re-draws are separated by question id only, and one is not independent of the original draw.
